notes.page_content: The opening continues a discussion of prime-to-p profinite completions in the sense of Artin-Mazur. The author contrasts the visibly approachable characteristic-zero programme with additional difficulty and mystery in positive characteristic, especially for varieties that resist lifting even birationally. After a horizontal rule he says these geometric considerations do not yet yield a precise programme for adequate algebraic structures. He then begins a question about linearising a homotopy type: how much cohomology with varying coefficients, multiplicative structure and possibly further cohomological operations is needed to recover the entire homotopy type? The last parenthesis is left open after disons, on this page.

notes.page_date_title_evidence: Author number 37 is visible at top centre. Archive pencil number 182 is at lower left in a distinct hand. There is no date, title, addressee, closing or signature on this sheet. External date and correspondence metadata asserted by H were not independently verified and are not manuscript text.
notes.paragraph_evidence: The opening is a continuation. A separate rule precedes the indented De ces paragraph. The final paragraph begins with a cancelled label and an indented Depuis. Je me continues the same paragraph across L11–L12; no new paragraph is inferred merely from a new sentence.
notes.mathematical_reading: The product expression is embedded in running prose and wraps between L20 and L21. Its coefficients and indices were read independently, including the agreed second j and tensor sign. The expected interpretation as a graded cohomological product prompted attention to the connector and the tiny output-degree sign, but did not decide their shapes. The unresolved dot/plus reading is preserved even though plus fits the familiar product interpretation.
notes.proof_status: No proof or independent mathematical verification was attempted. Reading the reconstruction question, tracing the product formula, and recognizing conventional notation are not claimed as mathematical checks. check_events is therefore empty.
